test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneously spelt word is '**Excepsional**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Excepsional**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Exceptional**'. • It means 'very unusual; unusually good'. (बहुत असाधारण; असामान्‍य रूप से अच्‍छा) • *Example: You will only be allowed to leave early in **exceptional** circumstances.* **Correct Answer:__** *Excepsional.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Intensify**: to become or to make something greater or stronger. (तीव्रतर, प्रबल या उग्रतर हो जाना या कर देना) • **Integrated**: to join things so that they become one thing or work together. (वस्‍तुओं को ऐसे जोड़ना कि वे एक हो जाएँ या साथ काम करें; एकीकृत करना) • **Imperative**: very important or urgent. (बहुत महत्वपूर्ण या आवश्‍यक; अत्‍यावश्‍यक) 229:T5b8, The erroneous part is** 'at long hours'.**
